# domeneshop_domain (Data Source)

Look up a single domain by name or by id. This is the usual way to get the `domain_id` that `domeneshop_dns_record` and `domeneshop_http_forward` need.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a domain by name — the usual way to get the domain_id that
# domeneshop_dns_record and domeneshop_http_forward need.
data "domeneshop_domain" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

# Or by id, when you already know it.
data "domeneshop_domain" "by_id" {
  id = 12345
}

# Every domain in the account, optionally filtered by substring.
data "domeneshop_domains" "all" {}

# Read records you do not manage with Terraform.
data "domeneshop_dns_records" "existing_mx" {
  domain_id = data.domeneshop_domain.example.id
  type      = "MX"
}

output "domain_id" {
  value = data.domeneshop_domain.example.id
}

output "all_domain_names" {
  value = [for d in data.domeneshop_domains.all.domains : d.domain]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain` (String) The domain name, e.g. `example.com`. Set this or `id`. Matched exactly, not as a substring.
- `id` (Number) The domain's numeric id. Set this or `domain`.

### Read-Only

- `dns` (Boolean) Whether Domeneshop hosts the DNS. Must be true to manage records.
- `email` (Boolean) Whether the email service is active.
- `expiry_date` (String) Date the registration expires.
- `nameservers` (List of String) The domain's nameservers.
- `registered_date` (String) Date the domain was registered.
- `registrant` (String) The registrant's name.
- `registrar` (Boolean) Whether Domeneshop is the registrar.
- `renew` (Boolean) Whether the domain auto-renews.
- `status` (String) One of `active`, `expired`, `deactivated`, `pendingDeleteRestorable`.
- `webhotel` (String) The web-hosting plan, or `none`.
